## Luke / Trent — Project Status Update

---

### 🟢 Andrea's Onboarding
Fast, autonomous learner — onboarding going very well.
- **Next:** Send Andrea's self-assessment to Amanda for comments once Andrea fills it out; pull Andrea in to help shape the bottom-of-funnel project.
- **Blocker:** None.

---

### 🟡 Q1 Bottom-of-Funnel OS Project
Framed the problem (clunky prospect-to-OS flow); solution is an unlisted landing page with buy/book button — shaping begins ~November after cycle 5 kicks off.
- **Next:** Pull in Andrea and a marketing-savvy customer to shape it.
- **Decision logged:** No form builder included.
- **Blocker:** Not starting shaping until cycle 5; sales team is ready and waiting.

---

### 🟡 Usage Tracking / Member Booked Appointments
Bare-minimum tracking (accessed/set up) is the target standard for future launches; Amplitude was cut.
- **Next:** Raise usage tracking at CSM DevSync; ask James to pull per-account usage counts for heavy-user outreach.
- **Blocker:** No tracking in place yet — limits feedback and marketing signal.

---

### 🟡 Intermountain Onboarding
Only Jen's facilities (Park City, part of Tosh) have meaningfully progressed after a fire-hose first call.
- **Next:** Future sessions should be hands-on/build-along format.
- **Blocker:** Onboarding approach needs to change before broader Intermountain progress is realistic.

---

### 🔴 Tactical Bundle (Melissa's Request)
No action — key features are at least 6 months out; Melissa has been told.
- **Decision logged:** Tactical bundle requests will not shape the OS roadmap.
- **Blocker:** Feature readiness. Holding the line here.

---

### 🟢 Pipeline
36 total; 6 demos MTD. October looks strong with 2–3 hot leads (Norwegian, Aussie).
- **Next:** Mobile booking and churn report come before groups for cycle 1 of 27 likely bottom-of-funnel leads.
- **Blocker:** None flagged — Luke wants to map good months against campaigns in December; dashboard is ready to support that.

---

### 🟡 Claude-Assisted Onboarding
In early testing phase.
- **Next:** Create fake onboarding script and feed into Claude onbo
